name: Air Hardening Modelling Clay Premium, White, 500 g (MMSP0005)
bestUse: Best for a first ring dish and trinket dish in soft colours
descriptionOriginal: A 500 g block of white air-hardening modelling clay from Mont Marte, sold as a single block with no kiln or oven needed.
whyWeLikeIt: White takes soft paint colours best, and 500 g is about enough for a ring dish and a trinket dish. Mont Marte publishes drying guidance and project tutorials for its clay, which is a help when you are new.
limitations: Like all air-dry clay, finished pieces are decorative only: not food-safe and not waterproof. The maker's drying time is a guide, and thicker pieces take longer. One block is enough for two small dishes, so buy a second for a tray or a restart.
qualityNote: Not yet recorded by Cowork. Retailers describe it as heavy-bodied and slow-drying, which is retailer wording, not the maker's.
